item.title: Scenic AVL #9 - Downtown to Windswept from First Baptist Church — Tue Nov 3, 6:00 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **Meeting Place:** Park in the First Baptist Church parking lot between the church and the YMCA. **Meeting Point:** [https://maps.app.goo.gl/zYYZFLSk7rg4pdrP6](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zYYZFLSk7rg4pdrP6) **Rating:** Strenuous for Pace and Distance **Surface:** Road and some trail **Mileage:** about 5.5 miles **Elevation Gain:** 750 **Pace:** 3.2 mph flats, slower on steep climbs. We will stop at the top of Windswept for a short break, and we will finish within 2 hours. We walk at a pretty fast pace, so please be aware of your capabilities. **5 minute rule: If you are more than 5 minutes behind the group, you will be asked to turn back.**
**Features:** Downtown points of interest, views from Windswept. Bears rarely seen. **After Eats:** Taco Temple **Dogs: Well behaved dogs are welcome.**

item.title: AT at Hot Springs to the Rich Mountain Fire Tower; 12.5 mile Fitness Loop Hike. — Wed Nov 4, 9:00 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group **MEETUP OPTIONS:** 8:15 AM To carpool at Weaverville walmart parking, lower level parking on the right. **OTHERWISE,** meet at the trailhead parking area @ 8:55 AM. Right turn just before the bridge at Hot Springs; quick left under the bridge to the riverside parking on the right. **Please comment if you plan to carpool.**
**DISTANCE:** approx. 13 miles. **ELEVATION GAIN**: Approximately 3,200'. ' This loop hike begins at the riverside parking area at Silvermine Rd. We will take the AT south to the Rich Mountain Fire Tower (see attached pic) spur and return on the Round Top Trail. The out bound hike {approximately 8 miles} has 2 extended climbs. The first is up and beyond Lover's Leep near Hot Springs, and the second begins at Tanyard Gap to the Fire Tower spur trail (total elevation gain of approximately 3,200'. item.title: First Friday Art Walk—Offset: Figurative Selections from the Sherman Print Portfolio — Fri Nov 6, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Join the Asheville Art Museum for First Friday Art Walks by Downtown Asheville Arts District. Enjoy our level 1 galleries and take in the Museum Store, as we extend our hours to 8pm, offering pay-what-you-wish admission after 6pm. First Friday Feature—Offset: Figurative Selections from the Sherman Print Portfolio Amidst the changing artistic landscape of 1960s New York, commercial printer Jules Sherman transformed his Manhattan printing plant into a “joyous atelier on the weekends.” Offset highlights 12 offset lithographs from an expansive portfolio of 118 produced in Sherman’s de facto atelier, exploring how each artist portrayed the human form within the dialogue of Abstract Expressionism and figurative art in this period. This exhibition is organized by the Asheville Art Museum and Hailey Kasney, curatorial intern. This exhibition project is supported by the International Fine Prints & Drawings Association (IFPDA) Foundation. Discover exhibitions on view:

item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Nov 8, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.
Source: Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Ashevi

📆 2nd Sunday of each month 🕰 Start Time: 12:30 PM
Better Together’s mission is to empower a racial awakening by building authentic relationships and deepening our understanding of our true connection to one another.
**💬 What to Expect** 🤝 Participate in — or simply observe — honest and sometimes challenging conversations ❤️ Dialogue always grounded in love, compassion, and respect for diverse perspectives 🌈 An opportunity to experience diversity, healing, and inclusion in community 🎤 Occasional guest speakers and special programs that enrich the conversation

There will be live music by The Commodore Fox Band later in the evening.
Let's meet out at 6:00 pm for a social time before the band takes the stage
**The Commodore Fox Band is a high‑energy, crowd‑pleasing party band led by Commodore Anders, known for playing rock and dance hits from the 1970s, 80s, and beyond, and for performing at community festivals, parks, and private events across North Carolina.**
### About the Band
The Commodore Fox Band is described as “toeing the line as your favorite party band,” delivering a mix of classic rock, disco, pop, and dance tracks that get people moving. Band leader **Commodore Anders** and his crew are noted for aiming to please audiences with a set that blends nostalgic favorites with contemporary hits.
